benchmark: NAFEMS Test 4M (2-D steady conduction, mixed Dirichlet/Robin/insulated boundaries)
source: NAFEMS Selected Benchmarks for Thermal Analysis

problem.boundary_conditions: y=0 Dirichlet (fixed_edge_C); x=0 insulated; x=width and y=height Robin (convection_W_m2K to ambient_C)

engine.name: scikit-fem
engine.solver_module: thermal_fe.py (build_tensor_mesh, solve_conduction, probe_point -- imported, not duplicated)

limitations: This reproduces one published benchmark point on this case's own solver code path; it does not itself qualify the spreader problem's different geometry, layered conductivity, or boundary layout -- it establishes that the shared assembly-and-solve routine those problems both call is correct on a problem with an independently published reference answer.
The relative deviation is computed from an already-rounded computed value against an exact reference; it is a deviation from one published benchmark point, not a general error bound.
